readme:
# Workable Jobs Scraper: apply.workable.com Company Boards

Get the open jobs of any company that hires through [Workable](https://www.workable.com). Paste a company board URL such as `https://apply.workable.com/unilabs` (or just the account name) and receive title, location, department, employment type, remote flag, posting date and apply URL as clean dataset rows.

## What you can do with it

- Pull all open roles of a list of target companies for lead generation or recruiting research.
- Track hiring over time: run it on a schedule with `postedWithinDays` and `sortBy: newest` to see only new postings.
- Feed a job board or alert system with the openings of the companies you follow.
- Filter by keyword in the title, by location or by country.

## What you get

One dataset row per job. Duplicates are removed before anything is charged, so the number of rows is the number of results you pay for.

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | Job id, unique across boards |
| `ats_job_id` | The id the portal itself uses for the posting |
| `title` | Job title |
| `company` | Account name of the board (the part after `apply.workable.com/`) |
| `ats_platform` | `workable` |
| `location`, `city`, `country` | Location text as posted, the city and the two-letter country code when they can be read from it |
| `department` | Department or team, when the board states one |
| `employment_type` | Full-time, part-time, contract and so on, when stated |
| `remote` | Remote flag, when the board states one |
| `workplace_type` | `on_site`, `hybrid` or `remote`, as the posting states it; empty when it does not say |
| `additional_locations` | The other locations of a posting that lists several (for example `Gauteng, South Africa`); `location` stays the first one |
| `description` | Full job description as HTML, with the requirements and benefits sections when the posting has them. Empty only when `includeDescription` is off or the posting page could not be read |
| `apply_url`, `job_url` | Link to the posting and to its application page |
| `created_at` | Posting date |
| `language` | Language of the posting text |
| `scraped_at` | Time of the run |

Salary fields (`salary_text`, `salary_min`, `salary_max`, `salary_currency`, `salary_period`, `salary_source`) are filled only when the posting states a salary (the salary range of the job, or a range in its description). They are never estimated.

## Input

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `companies` | Workable board URLs or bare account names (`unilabs` is `https://apply.workable.com/unilabs`). Strings, `{"url": "..."}` objects, a single string, or several separated by commas or new lines. Empty = one sample board. |
| `keywords` | Keep only jobs whose title matches at least one keyword. They filter the jobs of the boards you list; they do not search other companies. |
| `location` | Keep only jobs in this city, region or country (`London`, `Germany`, `DE`). |
| `countries` | ISO-2 codes such as `["US", "CA"]`: keep only jobs located in these countries (jobs whose country cannot be determined are left out). |
| `includeRemoteWithoutRegion` | Only with a country filter: also keep remote jobs that state no country or region (they may not be open to applicants in that country). Default `false`. |
| `postedWithinDays` | Drop jobs older than this many days. Jobs without a posting date are kept. |
| `sortBy` | `newest` (default) or `relevance` (the portal's own order). |
| `maxJobsPerCompany` | Cap per board, counted after the filters. `0` = all. Default 50. |
| `maxResults` | Cap for the whole run. The run stops cleanly when it is reached. `0` = no limit. Default 100. |
| `includeDescription` | Include the description HTML where the board provides one. Default `true`. |

### Example: one board

```json
{
  "companies": ["https://apply.workable.com/unilabs"],
  "maxResults": 20
}
```

### Example: several boards with filters

```json
{
  "companies": [
    "https://apply.workable.com/unilabs",
    "ems-group"
  ],
  "keywords": ["engineer", "data"],
  "postedWithinDays": 30,
  "sortBy": "newest",
  "maxJobsPerCompany": 25
}
```

Only Workable boards are read. A URL of any other job system (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday and so on) is skipped with a log line that names the actor to use, and is never charged.

### Supported URL formats

- Board: `https://apply.workable.com/{account}` (with or without a trailing slash, or without `https://`).
- Posting: `https://apply.workable.com/{account}/j/{SHORTCODE}/` is reduced to its board; the whole board is read.
- Bare account name: `{account}`.

## Output

```json
{
  "id": "workable-3c9d41aa-8A2F1B7C3D",
  "ats_job_id": "8A2F1B7C3D",
  "title": "Senior Backend Engineer",
  "company": "unilabs",
  "ats_platform": "workable",
  "location": "London, England, United Kingdom",
  "city": "London",
  "country": "GB",
  "department": "Engineering",
  "employment_type": "Full-time",
  "remote": false,
  "apply_url": "https://apply.workable.com/unilabs/j/8A2F1B7C3D/",
  "job_url": "https://apply.workable.com/unilabs/j/8A2F1B7C3D/",
  "language": "en",
  "created_at": "2026-10-20T09:12:44.000Z",
  "scraped_at": "2026-10-25T09:00:00Z"
}
```

The row above is illustrative; values depend on the board. `created_at` is the posting date the portal reports.

## Pricing

Pay per result. You pay the platform start fee per run and then only for the jobs you receive. Filtered-out and duplicate jobs are never charged. The pricing box on the actor page always shows the current rates.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Example prompts once connected:**

> "Use `workable-jobs-scraper` for https://apply.workable.com/unilabs and list the open roles with title, location and apply URL."

> "Use `workable-jobs-scraper` for the account names unilabs and ems-group and return the roles posted in the last 30 days."

Configure the MCP server with the Workable Jobs Scraper preconfigured at `mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/workable-jobs-scraper`:

```json
{
    "mcpServers": {
        "apify": {
            "command": "npx",
            "args": [
                "mcp-remote",
                "https://mcp.apify.com/?tools=santamaria-automations/workable-jobs-scraper",
                "--header",
                "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_API_TOKEN>"
            ]
        }
    }
}
```

See the auto-generated API tab on the actor page for language-specific examples (cURL, JavaScript, Python, and more).

## FAQ

**How do I find a company's Workable board URL?**
Open the company's careers page and look at the address of a job: if it starts with `apply.workable.com/`, the part right after it is the account name and `https://apply.workable.com/{account}` is the board URL. You can pass either the URL or just the account name.

**Can I search by keyword across all Workable companies?**
No. Give the board URL or account name of each company. Keywords only filter the titles of the jobs of the boards you list.

**What if a board is not found?**
The run continues with the other boards. The run status line names the board and the reason (for example `board_not_found`), and nothing is charged for it.

**Why is the description empty?**
The description is read from each job's own page, so it is empty when `includeDescription` is off, or when that page could not be read. The row still has title, location, department, employment type, date and the apply URL, and is charged the same.

**Why did I get fewer jobs than `maxJobsPerCompany`?**
The caps apply after your filters, and a board can simply have fewer open jobs. The boards are read in the order you list them, and the run stops once `maxResults` is reached.

## Limits

- Boards only; no company-name search across Workable.
- Salary fields are filled only when the posting states a salary.
- Descriptions depend on what the board provides.
